info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Create Market Data Financial Market Research-spec
info.description: The Financial Market Research Submission API enables users to submit comprehensive financial market research data for analysis and processing. This endpoint is designed for businesses seeking to contribute market intelligence to enhance forecasting and decision-making. It caters to financial analysts, market researchers, and investment professionals. Submissions facilitate data aggregation for improved insights into market trends and performance, reinforcing the financial institution's analytical capabilities.

post.summary: Create new financial market research data.
post.description: This operation allows you to create and submit financial market research data, enabling stakeholders to analyze trends, make informed decisions, and gain insights into various market dynamics.
